exposure: self-reported poor sleep quality on the first day after cesarean delivery
outcome: postpartum depression (PPD) measured by Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS) scores
cohort: The study included 256 women who underwent elective cesarean delivery under neuraxial anesthesia.
finding: Self-reported poor sleep quality on the first day after cesarean delivery was significantly correlated with higher EPDS scores and an increased rate of maternal PPD one month postpartum.
